data.name: Myth of Valderit
data.detailed_description:
Myth of Valderit is a psychological horror experience set in the cursed village of Valderit, inspired by the abandoned Catalan village of La Mussara. You wake up as Nil, separated from your friends Julia and Enric, and soon uncover the dark secrets lurking within the village…

This single-player, first-person experience combines exploration, survival, and puzzle-solving. Nil must endure and remain alive, evading the fanatical devotees of an unimaginable entity.

Discover the horrors that await you in Valderit. 

The Writer is an omniscient presence that observes every player and reshapes the world around them. Its Adaptive Horror System analyzes behavior in real-time, dynamically altering level design, atmosphere, music, and scares to bring out each player’s deepest fears.

Player reactions dynamically transition the game between distinct survival states, making every encounter personal and unpredictable. 

It also manipulates perception through a Madness mechanic inspired by Lovecraftian horror, warping reality itself. Shadows twist, sounds deceive, and the environment constantly shifts, heightening psychological tension and creating a nightmare unique to each individual.

In this world, The Writer does not just tell the story, it becomes the story, and every player must navigate the fear it writes around them.

To advance in the story and uncover the dark truths of Valderit, you will face twisted and challenging puzzles. Each puzzle is carefully designed to test your logic, observation, and problem-solving skills, while revealing new layers of the village’s sinister secrets. 

A Lovecraftian-inspired narrative takes you on a journey with a group of friends that begins in the forest near Valderit. After a few beers, the friends go to sleep…

In the blink of an eye, Nil is thrown back in time to 1693. There, he discovers the old church, a cursed town with its houses and catacombs, and a dense, oppressive atmosphere that reveals the darker side of reality.

Shadows whisper, rituals leave disturbing traces, and an ancient presence watches Nil’s every move, intent on eroding his mind until resistance gives way to devotion... In this journey, you must decide whether to flee, confront the unknown, or even sacrifice yourself…

data.short_description: Nil is trapped in a cursed village that appears only under the full moon. To escape, he must solve twisted puzzles and uncover hidden secrets. Myth of Valderit is a first-person psychological horror experience. The village is alive. It remembers. And it knows your deepest fears.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bits
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 o AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD RX 560 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: This information applies to the current state of our project demo, as well as the forecast for the full game in its current stage of production. We will provide updates in case of any possible changes due to production.

content_descriptors.notes:
In this game, no type of violence, sexual content, or sensitive content is shown directly.
However, the results of acts of violence that took place before the player arrives at certain locations will be visible, such as corpses and skeletons.

There is a single instance where adults aged 21+ can be seen consuming alcohol.

The only crime understood to occur in the game is murder (committed by those who are clearly identified as villains).
In this regard, we would like to emphasize two points:

At no time will murders be shown being carried out.

It is fiction and a fundamental part of the game to create a horror atmosphere. The team is completely against any kind of murder or aggression toward any person or animal, and we strongly condemn it.

There will be no form of apology for, or depiction of, sexual themes or suicide.
Furthermore, we want to stress that we do not promote any type of crime, or discrimination.
There is no political opinion expressed, either in favor of or against anyone.
